summary: Embedded escalation questions and owner resolutions in numbered builder handoffs. Added complete batch resolution, unified builder run results, removed standalone escalation storage and tools, and updated runtime instructions. npm run check passed all 260 tests.

Covers empty escalations, done with questions, nonsequential IDs, invalid options/recommendation, builder-supplied resolution, and invalid done probe combinations.
